name: vita-turbo-vpn
description: A VPN client for the whole PS Vita: every app and game through your own tunnel server (taiHEN plugin and app, firmware 3.60-3.74)
long_description: A taiHEN plugin (kernel module + Settings and quick-menu pages) and a LiveArea app, for HENkaku/Ensō on firmware 3.60 to 3.74.
